text: Total FY2032 revenue across all 15 SKUs is Rs1,128.45 Cr. Every SKU share percentage in this dossier is computed against this figure.
One SoC2 die costs $3.8762 at volume, which is Rs364 at the model's USD/INR rate of 94. The die cost is identical in every product that carries one, regardless of that product's price.
inputs: Tapeout Unit Economics!Per-die cost at volume ($)
cites: Tapeout Unit Economics!Per-die cost at volume ($)

text: The 3 A100 compute box SKUs together consume 11,626 SoC2 dies across FY2028-FY2032 and produce Rs90.30 Cr in FY2032. That die volume is 6.6% of the 174,908-chip NRE breakeven, so the compute line cannot fund the tapeout: the kits carry that volume. The line's role is adoption, not silicon margin.
formula: sum(units across A100 compute SKUs) / breakeven_chips * 100
inputs: Tapeout Unit Economics!Breakeven volume (chips to recover NRE)
cites: Tapeout Unit Economics!Breakeven volume (chips to recover NRE)

text: The 1ch:2ch:4ch unit mix is fixed at 2.5:1.5:1.0 in every revenue year FY2028-FY2032. A constant mix across five years is an input to the model, not a result of it, and real channel mix typically drifts as a line matures.
